name: Spiritus Natalis: A String Quartet Concert with Adlib Strings
description: A Christmas string quartet concert by Adlib Strings at Igreja dos Clérigos, with festive projections by OCUBO. Wednesday 23 December at 21:00, tickets from €24.
longDescription:
Two days before Christmas, Adlib Strings bring a string quartet programme to Igreja dos Clérigos. They play classical pieces alongside traditional Christmas melodies, while OCUBO's festive projections light up the Baroque interior.

Fever presents the concert as a Porto tradition that returns this year. It's recommended for ages 12 and up, and you can take photos and video during the performance if you keep the flash off.

The concert is on Wednesday 23 December at 21:00 at Igreja dos Clérigos, Rua de São Filipe de Nery. Tickets start at €24. Doors open 15 minutes before the start and there's nowhere to wait inside the church, so time your arrival.
